query:
INSERT INTO news (slug, title, excerpt, coverImageUrl, blocks, categoryId, date, publishedAt, createdAt)
VALUES (
  'the-book-club-play-cincinnati-playhouse',
  'Assistant Scenic Designer: The Book Club Play at Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park',
  'Supporting Jo Winiarski''s scenic design for Karen Zacarías''s comedy about books and the people who love them at Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park.',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/eALebXtpOxWNKivp.jpg',
  '[{"type":"text","content":"*The Book Club Play* brought me to Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park, one of the nation''s leading regional theatres, to support Jo Winiarski''s scenic design for Karen Zacarías''s charming comedy about literature, friendship, and the stories we tell ourselves."},{"type":"header","content":"The Production"},{"type":"text","content":"Directed by Blake Robison, Cincinnati Playhouse''s Producing Artistic Director, *The Book Club Play* follows the members of a devoted book club who become the subjects of a documentary filmmaker. As their intimate gatherings are captured on camera, the play explores how we perform our identities, the power of storytelling, and the deep connections forged through shared reading.\\n\\nJo Winiarski''s scenic design cleverly incorporated book references and meta-theatrical elements, creating a flexible environment that moved fluidly between the book club''s meeting space and the documentary filmmaker''s perspective. The design supported the play''s layered narrative structure while maintaining the warmth and intimacy essential to the story''s emotional core.\\n\\nThe production ran from March 22 through April 20, 2025, receiving enthusiastic reviews for its wit, heart, and celebration of literary community."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/eALebXtpOxWNKivp.jpg","caption":"The Book Club Play at Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park, 2025. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. The versatile set design incorporated book references and supported the play''s meta-theatrical framework. Photo courtesy Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park."},{"type":"header","content":"The Creative Team"},{"type":"team","title":"The Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Karen Zacarías","role":"Playwright"},{"name":"Blake Robison","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon P.T. Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Jorge Arroyo","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Matthew N. Nielson","role":"Sound Designer/Composer"},{"name":"Lauren T. Roark","role":"Costume Designer"},{"name":"Amoirie Perteet","role":"Projection Designer"}]},{"type":"header","content":"About Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park"},{"type":"text","content":"Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park is one of America''s most distinguished regional theatres, presenting bold, relevant, and entertaining work in two intimate venues. Located in Eden Park overlooking the city, the Playhouse has been a cornerstone of Cincinnati''s cultural landscape for over 60 years, producing world premieres, contemporary plays, and reimagined classics."},{"type":"link","url":"https://www.cincyplay.com","label":"Visit Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park"}]',
  90002,
  '2025-04-20',
  '2025-04-20',
  NOW()
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  title = VALUES(title),
  excerpt = VALUES(excerpt),
  coverImageUrl = VALUES(coverImageUrl),
  blocks = VALUES(blocks),
  categoryId = VALUES(categoryId),
  date = VALUES(date),
  publishedAt = VALUES(publishedAt);
